notes: Fresh Sep 8 Toronto-morning B_V1 gate over all 144 judge candidates. Every candidate was reviewed for entity accuracy and all five component dimensions. Accidental ticker mappings, evergreen/commentary/prediction content, class-action solicitation noise, low-materiality general-interest stories, weak/conflicting evidence and semantic duplicates were rejected. Eleven strongest distinct events cleared the conservative gate; fewer than 20 were retained rather than padding or wasting YouTube search quota.

events.event_title: Canada’s new retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods take effect

evidence.title: What to know about Canada’s new tariffs on the US amid trade war
Canada hits US with steep retaliatory tariffs, escalating trade war

events.verification_note: Use official Canadian tariff schedules for the precise covered goods and rates before publication.
